mostWorthwhile.text: Putting the hair cells into the cochlea was most worthwhile because the result explained how moving fluid ultimately changes signals to nerve fibers.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the hearing pathways felt relatively uneventful: the picture showed the connection, but added little explanation beyond what their name suggested.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The item titles and picture descriptions gave each construction a clear place in the route, though the steps were mostly predictable.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it explored a new relationship as clearly as the cochlea did. The assembly was understandable, though its predictable sequence offered few meaningful choices.
